description: This file defines the 'Event' Java entity class, representing a calendar event with fields such as id, title, description, start/end times, allDay flag, location, and color tag.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Java entity class for calendar events, mapped to 'events' table in database, with annotations for ORM and Swagger schema.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the event.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the event.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the event.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the event.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the event.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the event.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the event.

methods.name: isAllDay
methods.description: Indicates if the event is all-day.

methods.name: setAllDay
methods.description: Sets whether the event is all-day.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the event.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location of the event.

methods.name: getColorTag
methods.description: Returns the color tag associated with the event.

methods.name: setColorTag
methods.description: Sets the color tag for the event.
